source.name: Rough Skin
source.originalDescription: When damaged by a nearby opposing Melee Pokémon, reflects 12.5% of the damage received back to that opposing Pokémon as Attack-based damage (0.6s CD). When struck by a melee attack, a portion of the damage received is reflected back at the attacker.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rough Skin は 受けるダメージを軽減する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Gains 1 stack toward boosted attacks after hitting an auto attack or move, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, all basic attacks become boosted attacks with increased attack speed and additional 30% lifesteal, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon, and dealing an additional 10% remaining HP damage to them. All stacks decay after 4s of not hitting an auto attack or move. Against wild Pokémon: basic attack damage is capped at 1000; boosted attack damage is capped at 1100; additional remaining HP damage is capped at 350. Becomes a boosted attack with every fifth attack, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Every time a basic attack or move hits an enemy, basic attack speed is increased.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 通常攻撃速度を上げる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ、与ダメージに応じて回復する。

source.name: Livid Outrage
source.originalDescription: The user goes berserk, becoming unstoppable and receiving 30% reduced damage for 5s while unleashing five powerful attacks in a row. The user dashes forward and damages opposing Pokémon in a unique designated area with each attack, taking a brief moment after each attack to aim the next dash. Every attack more damage than the last. The fifth attack throws opposing Pokémon hit and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1s. The user is left confused for 0.5s afterward. Has the user unleash a powerful chain attack while dashing forward. The final attack throws enemies but also leaves the user unable to act for a short time. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Livid Outrage は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、シールドを付与する。
